shots.subject: A five-tier stone pagoda stands on a rocky hillside above a jade-green lake, layered grey-green mountain ranges behind it, the sky split into two horizontal bands of pale cream and pale teal.
shots.scene: A five-tier stone pagoda stands on a rocky hillside above a jade-green lake, layered grey-green mountain ranges behind it, the sky split into two horizontal bands of pale cream and pale teal.
shots.motion: Slow mist drifts across the lake, gentle ripples move on the water surface.
shots.note: 原片对位帧 c15；母版按 1152x864 出，横移 0.14 要吃满左右余量

shots.subject: A broken stone pagoda tilts on a riverbank, a pile of fallen bricks below it, a long band of ochre dust hanging in the air, pale green sky.
shots.scene: A broken stone pagoda tilts on a riverbank, a pile of fallen bricks below it, a long band of ochre dust hanging in the air, pale green sky.
shots.motion: Fine dust drifts slowly sideways through the air, the brick pile and the pagoda stay completely still.
shots.note: 原片对位帧 c15；斜塔不能给 I2V 大动作，砖堆在动就会散架

shots.subject: Three men in long scholar robes stand with their backs to us against a plain pale lilac wall, their silhouettes nearly black, no window.
shots.scene: Three men in long scholar robes stand with their backs to us against a plain pale lilac wall, their silhouettes nearly black, no window.
shots.motion: Fine dust motes drift slowly in the window light, the figures stay completely still.
shots.note: 原片对位帧 c66；背面剪影，不给手，所以可以进 I2V

shots.subject: A narrow stone staircase descends into a brick vaulted underground chamber, flat pale grey walls, a small hanging lamp on the right, a dark doorway at the bottom.
shots.scene: A narrow stone staircase descends into a brick vaulted underground chamber, flat pale grey walls, a small hanging lamp on the right, a dark doorway at the bottom.
shots.motion: The lamp flame flickers very slightly, thin dust drifts down the stairs.
shots.note: 原片对位帧 c65；2.22s 的短镜，属于允许保留的独句短镜

shots.subject: An extreme close-up of a large flat stone slab, one long pale crack running diagonally across it, cold white light glowing faintly from inside the crack.
shots.scene: An extreme close-up of a large flat stone slab, one long pale crack running diagonally across it, cold white light glowing faintly from inside the crack.
shots.motion: The white glow in the crack breathes very slowly, a thin thread of dust drifts across the stone.
shots.note: 原片对位帧 c65；10.76s 长镜靠 I2V 重定时放慢氛围层顶住，不能补帧

shots.subject: A square iron chest with brass corner fittings stands on the brick floor of an underground chamber, a few bronze coins scattered around it, flat pale yellow-grey palette.
shots.scene: A square iron chest with brass corner fittings stands on the brick floor of an underground chamber, a few bronze coins scattered around it, flat pale yellow-grey palette.
shots.motion: A little dust drifts slowly near the floor, the chest and the coins stay completely still.
shots.note: 原片对位帧 c65 偏冷，铁函镜走暖灰：warm 1.055/1.045/0.945 + 补 gamma 0.94
